description: This file defines the EdgeEffectHacker class, which provides a static method to apply a color filter to the edge and glow effects of scrollable views in an Android application, allowing for branding or customization of the visual effects.

classes.name: EdgeEffectHacker
classes.description: A utility class providing a method to apply a color filter to the overscroll glow and edge drawables in Android views.

methods.name: brandGlowEffect
methods.description: Applies a color filter to the overscroll glow and edge drawables of a given activity's views to customize their appearance.
